summary: The Municipalidad Provincial de Ica and Instituto Catastral de Lima are evidenced as the local cadastral custodians/project operators. Public official notices and procedures were verified, but the Catastro Ica site timed out and no anonymous response containing a safe native parcel ID plus full polygon geometry was obtained. Runtime remains held.
